name: Superlon Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年公司没有公告涉及业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售，公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会、股息除权及股份回购豁免等公司治理事项。最新一季（截至2026年7月31日）营收同比增长17.0%，净利润同比增长150.8%。
overview_en: There were no announcements this year involving expansion, new business, reduction or disposal of business segments; In the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue grew 17.0% year-on-year and net profit grew 150.8% year-on-year.
